residual_risks: Resolving the proposed negative edges would require reviewing the cited progeny records beyond the disclosed Acevedo file.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use 'No confirmed adverse treatment in the disclosed lake judgment fields; proposed negative-edge audit pending' if the audit has not been completed.
